Overview

The HydraFacial is a multi-step facial treatment that simultaneously cleanses, exfoliates, extracts, and hydrates your skin. Suitable for all skin types with zero downtime.

Key Benefits

Instant visible glow
Deep pore cleansing
Zero downtime
Hydration boost
Suitable for all skin types
Non-irritating

Treatment Process

Cleansing & vortex exfoliation

2

Acid peel (mild)

5

6

SPF protection
